result.title: Risk-Triggered Search: Behavior-Preserving Safe Control
result.summary: Pre-trained visual world models generate multi-step action plans from current and goal observations, yet terminal-proximity objectives fail to prevent forbidden-zone traversal or rigid-body collision sliding. Purely visual interfaces may lack analytical dynamics, structured states, or explicit collision geometry, requiring internal prediction of action-conditioned process risk. We propose Risk-Triggered Search (RTS) for frozen Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models. Rather than relying on static state features that cannot distinguish candidate plans sharing an observation, RTS unrolls action-conditioned future latent prefixes in the frozen world model and trains a lightweight risk head with process-violation supervision. To intervene selectively while preserving safe nominal behavior, RTS uses the same predicted prefix-risk criterion as both the search trigger gate and hard feasibility gate: safe nominal plans execute directly, whereas alarms trigger local Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) search to minimize nominal deviation within the feasible set. To prevent isotropic Euclidean minimal modification from shrinking obstacle-directed actions into zero-amplitude stalling, we introduce an amplitude-preserving metric $d_{\mathrm{AP}}$ that retains tangential progression while maintaining a unique zero at the nominal plan. Under unified gating and this unique-zero condition, bypassing safe-state search yields closed-loop trajectories strictly identical to every-step same-kernel search. Evaluated under a process-safety benchmark and Safe Arrival Rate (SAR) metric across five tasks, RTS improves SAR over Direct by 12.67--41.67 percentage points on navigation and articulated control and +2.08/+4.17 pp on Cube/PushT boundary cohorts, maintaining 100% action identity with every-step search while cutting controller time by 17.71%--70.41% across 1,968 paired trajectories.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为冻结的 JEPA 视觉世界模型提出 Risk-Triggered Search：在潜空间展开动作条件下的未来潜前缀，训练轻量风险头做过程违规预测，并用同一前缀风险同时充当搜索触发门与可行性门，仅在告警时启用局部 CEM 搜索，另引入保幅距离度量避免规避动作退化为停滞。
AI.relevance_reason: 文中「静态状态特征无法区分共享同一观测的候选计划」的判断与潜前缀风险监督，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 是否保留任务必要信息、以及何时追加计算或停止的门控判据；保幅距离也可类比 latent 相似度中内容与几何结构的影响，但需核查其是否可迁移到多模态推理。
